event_chain.summary: Engineer photographs and films R&D documents with a hidden camera

summary: On March 28, April 4 and April 5, 2026 Yeh Yen-wei, a senior engineer at Taiwanese DRAM maker Nanya Technology, smuggled an Insta360 action camera hidden in a bag of snacks into restricted areas and used his legitimate credentials to open internal R&D systems, photographing and filming documents on DRAM process technology for use in China. Nanya's IT security team spotted the camera's abnormal Bluetooth and Wi-Fi signals and matched them to his access logs; forensics found no evidence the material left the company. He was indicted under Taiwan's Trade Secrets Act.
